items.question: How long is the extension granted on a UAE residence visa to a divorced woman or widow who was living on her husband's visa?
items.fact: Divorced or widowed woman's residence visa extended by one year

items.question: What fine is charged for each 30 days or less spent outside the UAE when applying for an entry permit after staying abroad for over 6 months?
items.gold: AED 100 for every 30 days or less spent outside the country.
items.fact: Entry permit after 6 months abroad: AED 100 per 30 days
